description: Use this when the user calls off planned work: a scheduled or running maintenance window, or a recurring schedule as a whole. Cancels it as the dashboard's Maintenance page does; the subscribers who were told about it are emailed that it will not happen. Returns the cancelled window. A window already cancelled is left as it is. Not for an incident: use draft_incident_post with kind resolve.

maintenance.description: The window: its id from list_incidents with kind maintenance, or its title.

site.description: The window's site: its id, name or part of its URL.

name: cancel_maintenance
title: Cancel a maintenance window
